title: S4 excerpt-1
example_chapter: I got to the platform early, which was my first mistake. The board said the 6:12 was running late, and the board had been saying that since March. A man in a yellow coat was eating an orange with great ceremony, one segment at a time, and I watched him instead of the tracks because the tracks made me think of Ilya. When the train finally slid in, it was nearly empty. I took the seat by the window and put my bag on the seat beside me so nobody would sit there. Nobody tried. By the second station I had started to feel foolish, the way you do when you have arranged a whole scene for someone who isn't coming.
